records.text: After Benjamin Netanyahu said Venezuela was antisemitic, the United States removed Nicolás Maduro.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Trump told us no more forever wars. They definitely marketed themselves as pro-peace, him and Vance. That was the ticket that they ran on until Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu) said Venezuela is anti-Semitic. Then we took out Maduro.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 38:27. The United States captured and removed Maduro in January 2026, and Israeli sources had criticized antisemitism associated with Venezuela's regime. Searches found no reliable source for the specific Netanyahu statement or evidence connecting it causally to the U.S. operation.

records.text: Venezuela sent its first oil shipment to Israel in years as relations improved.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And guess who benefited from that? I loved this headline so much. Venezuela sends first oil shipment to Israel in years in signs of relations improving.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 38:43. Bloomberg and contemporaneous reporting confirmed a Venezuelan crude cargo to Israel in February 2026, the first such shipment since about mid-2020, amid reopening contacts after Maduro's removal.

records.text: Donald Trump said Venezuela had worked out well and that millions of barrels of Venezuelan oil had been brought to Houston and Louisiana, where refineries were operating around the clock and making money.
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

appearances.snippet: But we did it with Venezuela. Venezuela has worked out great for everybody. We've taken millions and millions of barrels of oil out of Venezuela. We've brought them to Houston and various other places. Louisiana. where we're you know refineries that we have that are incredible they're going 24 hours a day making a fortune

verification.notes: The source clip records Trump saying Venezuela had worked out well, that millions of barrels had gone to Houston and Louisiana, and that refineries were running around the clock and making money. Current EIA data and reporting confirm sharply increased Venezuelan crude imports into Gulf Coast refineries, led by Texas and Louisiana.

records.text: Owens claimed that oil taken from Venezuela began being shipped immediately to Israel.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He says Venezuela was a success. I think Americans would disagree. Oh, we got all this oil. Where did it go? I remember the headlines. They started shipping it immediately to Israel.

verification.notes: Bloomberg reported a Venezuelan crude cargo heading to Israels Bazan refinery on February 10, 2026, the first in years and roughly five weeks after Maduro was captured. That supports the core shipment claim, but immediately is imprecise and the Venezuelan government publicly denied that it had sent or sold the cargo, leaving the exact transaction disputed.
